claims.claim: Failed fresh-login attempt invalidates old epoch and clears refresh before response
claims.basis: success.request.handler.ts:10-19 invalidates and clears; success.response.handler.ts:74-83 repeats on successful login. A failed attempt does not restore old refresh. Whether an active session can submit replacement login is not established.

claims.claim: Late success from old epoch rejects as cancellation and may cause unhandled rejection
claims.basis: succes.response.handler.ts:35-44 deliberately throws CanceledError. Local extend, refresh and logout paths catch their own failures. Other external or local consumers have not been exhaustively verified.

claims.claim: getRefreshToken must obtain new access when stored refresh is reusable
claims.basis: service/index.ts:48-85 calls the refresh-token endpoint and supplies current access; relogin obtains renewed access separately. Behavior on expired access in production remains outside this claim.

claims.claim: Opaque or iat-less renewal access is rejected
claims.basis: succes.response.handler.ts:45-71 requires parseable JWT with finite exp and iat. Baseline accepted response without this validation. Deployed BFF token contract has not been confirmed.

claims.claim: Acquisition promise resolves even when request fails
claims.basis: service/index.ts:39-45 documents settlement only; lines 78-97 swallow the failure. Callers must inspect credentials and tests cover failure fallback.
